clauses.title: Reasonable & Customary Repair Rates
clauses.rule: Prevailing territorial labor rate cap enforced; non-OEM parts allowed after 3 model years.

clauses.title: Collision Deductible
clauses.rule: $500 deductible waived only if third party admits fault with verified policy.

clauses.title: Commercial Rideshare Exclusion
clauses.rule: Zero coverage during TNC app period 1, 2, or 3 unless endorsement RS-99 attached.

clauses.title: Sudden & Accidental Water Discharge
clauses.rule: Covers pipe bursts and appliance discharge; excludes continuous leaks over 14 days.

clauses.title: Emergency Mitigation Requirement
clauses.rule: Insured must take prompt reasonable measures to mitigate water damage.

clauses.title: Fraud and Material Misrepresentation
clauses.rule: Policy rendered void ab initio if intentional misrepresentation or staged loss is discovered.

ragIndexMetadata.chunkingStrategy: Hierarchical clause chunking with metadata filtering
